hypotheses.text: The co-occurrence of distal motor and sensory axonal polyneuropathy (CMT2) in an individual with developmental delay or intellectual disability has a positive predictive value greater than 90% for DHX9 over DHX30-related neurodevelopmental disorder.
hypotheses.rationale: Axonal Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (CMT2) phenotypes have been identified specifically in individuals harboring DHX9 missense variants (associated with aberrant nucleolar accumulation), whereas peripheral axonal neuropathy is not part of the established phenotypic spectrum of DHX30-related neurodevelopmental disorder.

evidence.text: Phenotypes in individuals with monoallelic DHX9 variants ranged from neurodevelopmental disorders to the distal symmetric polyneuropathy axonal Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (CMT2), whereas CMT2-associated variants specifically drove nucleolar accumulation.

source.title: Monoallelic variation in DHX9, the gene encoding the DExH-box helicase DHX9, underlies neurodevelopment disorders and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease
source.journal: The American Journal of Human Genetics
source.quote: Phenotypes ranged from NDDs to the distal symmetric polyneuropathy axonal Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (CMT2).

hypotheses.text: Ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy or primary cardiac conduction defects distinguish DHX9 helicase ATP-binding motif variants from DHX30-related disorders, in which structural septal defects or structurally normal hearts predominate.
hypotheses.rationale: Yamada et al. identified left ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy and cardiac conduction abnormality in a patient and mouse model with a missense variant in the DHX9 ATP-binding motif (p.Gly414Arg), whereas DHX30-related cardiac involvement typically comprises non-specific structural defects or is absent.

evidence.text: A patient with a de novo missense variant p.(Gly414Arg) in the DHX9 ATP-binding site presented with short stature, intellectual disability, and ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy, with knock-in mice exhibiting cardiac conduction abnormality.

source.quote: Herein, we report a patients with a heterozygous de novo missense variant, p.(Gly414Arg) of DHX9 who presented with a short stature, intellectual disability, and ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy.

hypotheses.text: Subcellular mislocalization to the nucleolus or cytoplasm on patient-derived fibroblasts or cellular assays definitively differentiates DHX9 pathogenic variants from DHX30 pathogenic variants, which alter stress granule dynamics rather than nucleolar sequestration.
hypotheses.rationale: Calame et al. and Yamada et al. demonstrated that DHX9 pathogenic variants alter nucleocytoplasmic shuttling (NLS variants accumulate in the cytoplasm, CMT2 variants accumulate in the nucleolus, and G414R shows aberrant nucleocytoplasmic distribution), representing a distinct pathomechanistic footprint compared to DHX30 variants.

evidence.text: Whereas wild-type DHX9 was restricted to the nucleus, NLS missense variants abnormally accumulated in the cytoplasm, and CMT2-associated missense variants caused aberrant nucleolar DHX9 accumulation.

source.quote: CMT2-associated missense variants caused aberrant nucleolar DHX9 accumulation, a phenomenon previously associated with cellular stress.

new_directions.question_text: What is the exact incidence and penetrance of subclinical peripheral axonal neuropathy on electromyography/nerve conduction studies (EMG/NCS) among pediatric patients diagnosed primarily with DHX9-related neurodevelopmental disorder?
new_directions.rationale: If electrophysiological evidence of subclinical axonal polyneuropathy is present in DHX9-associated NDD individuals prior to overt motor milestone loss, EMG/NCS could serve as an accessible, high-specificity diagnostic test to distinguish DHX9 from DHX30 without requiring functional assays.

new_directions.question_text: Are cardiac conduction abnormalities and ventricular non-compaction restricted exclusively to nucleotide-binding domain (Walker A/B motif) missense variants of DHX9?
new_directions.rationale: Confirming whether cardiomyopathy is unique to ATP-binding site variants like p.Gly414Arg or extends to loss-of-function and NLS variants will define whether routine echocardiography and Holter monitoring should be universal or stratified by variant locus.
